history.summary: Refs register on the scope root `$refs` reads: a module WeakMap `scopeRoots` (scope → root element), filled by initScope, getStrayScope (body) and each l-for row scope (inherits its parent's root). handleRef resolves through it before falling back to findScopeRoot, so refs inside l-if clones, l-for rows, l-teleport and stray elements are no longer stranded on the clone/element. Refs are now reactive: __faqirRefs is created on first read and written through reactive(), so effects reading $refs.x re-run when it appears or goes; l-for is last-row-wins, cleared when that row goes. +~30 B gzip. Six regressions in runtime-fixes.test.ts. Session also fixed a red baseline: the v1.1.1 release left SKILL.md's CDN pin and site/lib/faqir-audit.js's version at 1.1.0 (588c30e).

Property-aware bindings: engine helper writeProp (writes only when different; checked/selected dispatch a bubbling faqir:model, never a native change); handleBind sets the property for checked/selected/muted/indeterminate/value, and handleModel routes its switch/checkbox/radio/select writes through it. toggle-group re-syncs on faqir:model and form reset without faqir:change (listeners removed in destroy); manifest 1.1.1. l-model tests moved off Faqir.start() into a container. +0.41 KB gzip. Session also rebuilt the Bun-pinned artifacts: this machine's 1.4.2 fails check:audit-browser/CDN-pin tests, so the suite was run with Bun 1.3.8 first on PATH.

Inserted content starts its controllers before l-init / first l-effect. l-if and l-for render through renderThenInit: l-init (handleInit and initScope's) and l-effect's first run go through runInit into a module-level pendingInits queue while a structural render is open; after insertion the inserted nodes' controllers start (connected nodes only) and the queue flushes, untracked. Nested renders join the outermost. Faqir.initTree starts a connected root's controllers first; the observer calls startControllers(node) before initTree. Bootstrap/observer sweeps share startControllers. README + @ui:directive l-init line state the order. +80 B gzip. Six regressions in runtime-fixes.test.ts. Follow-up 1.1F-36 (l-teleport inside inserted content; root l-init ordering asymmetry).
